source.title: C# Programming Yellow Book, Rob Miles, 'Cheese' Edition 8.1 (Dec/2019)

sections.title: Computers; Programs and Programming
sections.summary: Computer, data vs information, what programming is; specification (FDS) before code; metadata; proving that it works.

sections.title: Programming Languages
sections.summary: Languages reduce ambiguity compared with English; the language is not the most important thing.

sections.title: C#
sections.summary: C# looks like C++/Java; managed vs unmanaged code; compiled language; Visual Studio and the .NET Framework of the time; the source file and what it contains.

sections.title: A First C# Program
sections.summary: GlazerCalc program: using System, class, static void Main (only one), Console.ReadLine, double.Parse, string concatenation; layout does not matter to the compiler.

sections.title: Manipulating Data
sections.summary: Table of integer types, float/double/decimal, char and string (escapes, @), bool, identifiers, assignment, expressions, widening/narrowing, cast, integer division.

sections.title: Writing a Program
sections.summary: Comments, if/else, relational and logical operators (== with float is not meaningful), const, do-while/while/for, break/continue, ++ and +=, formatting {0:0.00}.

sections.title: Methods
sections.summary: Methods, parameters vs arguments, return, named/optional arguments, pass by value, ref and out, method libraries.

sections.title: Variables and Scope
sections.summary: Block scope, nested blocks may not repeat names, for-loop variable, class members; static is different from const.

sections.title: Arrays
sections.summary: new int[n], zeroed elements, zero-based index, going outside the array crashes the program, const for the size, 2D/3D arrays, initializers.

sections.title: Exceptions and Errors
sections.summary: Parse throws an exception; try/catch; Exception.Message; nesting; 'do not catch everything'; finally; throw new Exception; exception etiquette.

sections.title: The Switch Construction
sections.summary: switch with numbers and strings, default, several cases sharing one block, ToUpper/ToLower for commands.

sections.title: Using Files
sections.summary: Streams, StreamWriter (replaces an existing file), Close is mandatory, System.IO, StreamReader/EndOfStream, paths with @.

sections.title: Case Study: Friendly Bank; Enumerated Types
sections.summary: Bank case study; enum creates a type with named values; use enumerated types.

sections.title: Structures
sections.summary: struct groups fields; assignment copies values; unassigned local fields cause an error; passed by value.

sections.title: Objects, Structures and References
sections.summary: Structs by value vs objects by reference; new; several references to the same object; Garbage Collector; why references exist.

sections.title: Designing With Objects
sections.summary: Encapsulation (private/public), naming convention, accessor, tests and TDD.

sections.title: Static Items
sections.summary: static belongs to the class; static does not mean constant; private static data; a static method cannot use instance members.

sections.title: The Construction of Objects
sections.summary: Default constructor, own constructor, overloading, this(...), a constructor does not fail (it throws an exception).

sections.title: From Object to Component (Interfaces)
sections.summary: Interface = set of methods; name starts with I; implementing; reference through an interface; several interfaces; interfaces are promises.

sections.title: Inheritance
sections.summary: Inheritance (:), override/virtual, protected, base, new (do not replace methods), sealed, constructors in hierarchies, abstract vs interface.

sections.title: Object Etiquette
sections.summary: Everything inherits from object; ToString is virtual; == compares references, Equals compares content; this as a reference.

sections.title: The power of strings and chars
sections.summary: string is immutable; == compares text; Substring, Length, ToUpper, Trim, char methods, StringBuilder.

sections.title: Properties (and delegates)
sections.summary: Properties get/set/value, read-only, in interfaces, problems; delegates (type-safe) and events.

sections.title: Building a Bank (hash table)
sections.summary: Storing accounts in an array, sequential search, hash table, Hashtable with 'as'.

sections.title: Generics and Collections
sections.summary: ArrayList (object, cast, not typesafe), List<T>, Dictionary<TKey,TValue>; prefer List and Dictionary.

sections.title: Storing Business Objects
sections.summary: Save/Load with try/catch/finally and Close, streams as parameters, factory with GetType().Name.

sections.title: Business Objects and Editing
sections.summary: A business object validates its own data; the UI uses that validation; text menus; numbers instead of messages.

sections.title: Threads and Threading
sections.summary: Thread, ThreadStart, Start, lost update on a shared counter, Monitor.Enter/Exit, deadly embrace, Sleep/Join/Abort, processes.

sections.title: Structured Error Handling
sections.summary: Base Exception, custom exception types, throw, several catch blocks (System.Exception last), handlers need testing.

sections.title: Program Organisation
sections.summary: Several source files, csc /target:library, /reference, DLL hell, namespaces and qualified names.

sections.title: A Graphical User Interface (WPF/XAML)
sections.summary: WPF/XAML (dated): elements, properties, events with delegates (+= / -=), error handling with MessageBox.

sections.title: Debugging
sections.summary: Fault report, two kinds of fault, 'bugswatting', tips, fixes cause bugs, there is no perfect software.

sections.title: The End?
sections.summary: What was left out: serialization, attributes, reflection, networking; continuous development.

sections.title: Glossary of Terms
sections.summary: Entries from Abstract to Virtual Method.
